rules.comparator: cmp4 = every v8 flag off (= engine 4.0.0, tests/test_v8.js) on the same honest inputs, same fights, common random numbers
rules.contrasts: sub-part x: arm 'all' minus arm '-x' (leave-one-out, paired); package: the kept configuration minus cmp4
rules.total_deviance: per fight: mean over the 10 stats of (per-fighter Poisson deviance / cmp4's train mean deviance of that stat); x100 = mean relative change in %; the plan's 'total 10-stat Poisson deviance' (raw sum reported too)

keep_mean_moving.K2: no single stat worse: for each of the 10 stats, the deviance difference's CI lower bound <= 0
keep_mean_moving.K3: TD and control MAE not worse beyond the CI: td_lnd, td_att and ctrl MAE difference CI lower bound <= 0
keep_mean_moving.K4: TD-attempt PIT of the arm with the sub-part (fight-sides, randomized PIT): inside the 80% band >= 0.78 and above P90 <= 0.12
keep_mean_moving.K5: winner log loss, 7-bin and method: CI upper <= +0.002
keep_mean_moving.K6: base rates of the arm with the sub-part (train, pooled): KO share +-0.02, SUB +-0.015, DEC +-0.035, KD per 100 head +-12% rel, TD per 15 +-10% rel, control per 15 +-10% rel of actual (mlcal tolerances; DEC = KO + SUB tolerance since its error is minus their sum and the draw share's)

keep_spread.S1: its stat's PIT calibration error CE = |in80 - 0.80| + |>P90 - 0.10| + |<P10 - 0.10| (fight-sides) is lower with the sub-part: CI upper of the CE difference < 0 (CE recomputed per resample)
keep_spread.S2: deviance not worse in the plan's gate sense ('no single stat worse', 'not worse beyond the CI'): the total relative deviance difference and every one of the 10 stats' deviance differences have a CI lower bound <= 0
keep_spread.why: a mean-preserving spread draw cannot lower the deviance of the mean by construction, and the plan's PIT criterion (K4) needs the TD-intent draw; reading K1 literally for these sub-parts would make the cycle's own criteria contradict each other, so their improvement criterion is the purpose they serve (PIT), and the deviance criterion is 'not worse' in the same CI sense the plan uses for 'no single stat worse' and the MAE criterion (a 0.5%-of-level bound, as in V6_V10_PLAN 6.3, is narrower than the paired train CI of the large counts, so a sub-part with no effect would fail it)

rules.package: the kept configuration vs cmp4 must pass K1-K6 (as a package); the version's gate PASSES only if at least one sub-part is kept and the package passes
rules.final_configuration: kept = all four -> arm 'all'; three -> arm '-x'; otherwise one pre-registered confirmation run of the kept configuration (same command, arms cmp4 + final) is binding for the package check
rules.bootstrap: 20,000 event-cluster resamples (card = event + date), seed 7; Monte Carlo SE of each bound (10 batches); a bound within 2 MC SE of its threshold is decided by the clustered normal bound
rules.tests: every test listed in the protocol must pass on the candidate files before the binding run, except the tests the protocol names as tolerated (with the reason)
rules.scope: the binding checks use the 2020-2023 train fights (1,606): 2019 has no earlier 2019+ year to fit the cycle's inputs on (no leak-free statlines table, the fold-honest embedding recipe for 2019 is the identity), so on 2019 fights every v8 arm runs as cmp4 does; the 2019-2023 values (all 1,999 fights) are reported as a secondary, never decisive
